notes: Token, CI-minute and PR limits are explicit ceilings, not targets. Monetary limits stay null until the owner sets a figure; until then no paid model, cloud or vendor spend may be started. Within an invocation, stop at the first of: these limits, the host-exposed budget, a circuit breaker, no ready work, or a genuine owner/external authority gate.

units.token_budget: model tokens per interactive invocation; stop and checkpoint when reached even if the host allows more
units.ci_minutes_budget: GitHub Actions minutes per calendar month across all workflows
units.max_pull_requests_per_invocation: merged or opened PRs per invocation before a checkpoint summary to the owner
units.model_cost_budget: USD per month; null until the owner sets a figure
units.cloud_cost_budget: USD per month; null until paid hosting is approved
